[[File:Reknew.jpg|thumb]]
The '''reknew''' was a long-living [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew in and around [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. This tree was very slow to [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[Plant/Legends|plant]] also was used to help the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] colonize [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]].
